newsitem.title: THAILAND: Padaeng says zinc mine resumes operations.
newsitem.headline: Padaeng says zinc mine resumes operations.

text.p: Thailand's Padaeng Industry Plc resumed its zinc mining operations last month after having closed them because of the monsoon, company officials said on Tuesday.
The operations at its mine in the northern province of Tak were shut in August and September, they told Reuters.
They said the remaining reserves of zinc silicate at the mine were estimated at 600,000 tonnes.
The company uses zinc silicate in combination with imported zinc sulphide concentrate to feed 150,000 tonnes of the material annually to its 73,800 tonne-a-year refinery.
"The mixture reduces production costs and ensures that Padaeng can continue operating its silicate mine for at least four years," one official said.
She added that the company planned to expand its annual capacity to 105,000 tonnes early next year and it was confident the expansion would be on schedule.
